decision.rationale: The time limit is met. TXN-008056 posted on 2026-08-23 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-25, which is 63 days later and within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The posted amount is 2511 cents and the authorised amount on AUTH-008250 (contactless, approved, not flagged for fraud) is 2347 cents, so the difference is 164 cents. No merchant receipt is attached. The cardholder's figure of 23.47 EUR is a claim, not a receipt, and it equals the authorised amount. MER-000056 (Lumen Bistro) is a RESTAURANT. 20% of the authorised amount is 469.4 cents, and the 164-cent difference is within that. Under amount-restaurant-tip, a difference within this tolerance counts as an agreed tip, not a mismatch, so the dispute is declined.

proposed_actions.reason: The restaurant authorised 23.47 EUR and posted 25.11 EUR. The 1.64 EUR difference is less than 20% of the authorised amount. Restaurants are allowed to add up to that much as a tip, so this is not a billing error, and we cannot refund it through a dispute.
